delivery_rule: Each author receives these common rows plus exactly one seat-packets/<seat>.json and the external/source rows named by that packet. No author receives another seat packet, another seat's source, peer design notes, validator topology fixtures, candidate bytes, review bytes, or benchmark results.
observable_contract: At the current UTF-16 offset consume the maximal CSS Syntax 3 §4.3.13 number prefix and return exactly one ordinary {value,type,sign} leaf while preserving the transactional failure and diagnostics contracts in feature-row.json.

direct_ast_floor.source_shape: Imports plus exactly one exported initialized const named consumeNumber; the export initializer is the entire reachable construction graph.
direct_ast_floor.allowed_callbacks: Only expression-bodied inline arrows passed directly to a recognized combinator map/chain call; no callback may name state, src, source, cursor, offset, index, slice, scanner, token, atom, CST, or component value.
direct_ast_floor.forbidden: Every other function-like node; helpers; receiver aliases or unproven receivers; statements; loops; mutation; constructors; classes; dynamic import; lazy/recursive graphs; manual state/source access; slicing/indexing; broad remainder regexes; lexer/scanner/token/atom/component/CST aggregates.
direct_ast_floor.orthogonality: No combinator-call count is evidence. Mechanical directness is necessary only. Five skeptics must reach a substantive provenance, lineage, idiom, KISS, and construction conclusion for the exact candidate set, and three adjudicators must unanimously select one already unblocked exact hash.
